A museum that looks like a cloud.

A new museum in Los Angeles brings together pictures, films and stories. The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opened to the public last month. George Lucas, who created Star Wars, and his wife, Mellody Hobson, started the museum.

Chinese architect Ma Yansong designed the building. He wanted it to look like a cloud floating above the park. People can enjoy the outdoor space below it. His ideas came partly from Chinese gardens and from growing up near lakes and gardens in Beijing.

Inside, visitors can explore different ways of telling stories with pictures. The displays include comics, paintings and things used in films. The museum's collection has more than forty thousand works. The building and its art bring ideas from different cultures together in one place for visitors to enjoy.
